- Meta (FY2025)
  - Net income = $60,458 million [Form 10-K | meta | FY2025 Q4 | p. 90].  
  - Revenue = $200,966 million [Form 10-K | meta | FY2025 Q4 | p. 73].  
  - Net income margin = (60,458 / 200,966) × 100 = 30.08%.

Conclusion: Alphabet’s FY2025 net income margin ≈ 32.79% (highest) [PDF | alphabet | FY2025 Q4 | p. 50] [Earnings Release | alphabet | FY2025 Q4 | p. 1].

Short answer: Meta had the largest 2025 year‑over‑year revenue growth rate (≈22.17%).

- Alphabet total revenue, Year ended Dec 31, 2025: $402,836 (in millions) [PDF | alphabet | FY2025 Q4 | p. 61].

  Growth = (402,836 − 350,018) / 350,018 × 100 = 15.09% (calculation using 2025 [$402,836; PDF | alphabet | FY2025 Q4 | p. 61] and 2024 [$350,018; PDF | alphabet | FY2025 Q4 | p. 61]).

- Meta total revenue, Year ended Dec 31, 2025: $200,966 (in millions) [Form 10‑K | meta | FY2025 Q4 | p. 73].  
  Meta total revenue, Year ended Dec 31, 2024: $164,501 (in millions) [Form 10‑K | meta | FY2025 Q4 | p. 73].  
  Growth = (200,966 − 164,501) / 164,501 × 100 = 22.17% (calculation using 2025 [$200,966; Form 10‑K | meta | FY2025 Q4 | p. 73] and 2024 [$164,501; Form 10‑K | meta | FY2025 Q4 | p. 73]).

- Netflix total revenue, Year ended Dec 31, 2025: $45,183,036 (in thousands) [Netflix FY2025 annual report / Form 10‑K | netflix | FY2025 Q4 | p. 24].  
  Netflix total revenue, Year ended Dec 31, 2024: $39,000,966 (in thousands) [Netflix FY2025 annual report / Form 10‑K | netflix | FY2025 Q4 | p. 24].  
  Growth = (45,183,036 − 39,000,966) / 39,000,966 × 100 = 15.86% (calculation using 2025 [$45,183,036; Netflix FY2025 annual report / Form 10‑K | netflix | FY2025 Q4 | p. 24] and 2024 [$39,000,966; Netflix FY2025 annual report / Form 10‑K | netflix | FY2025 Q4 | p. 24]).

- Netflix FY2025 revenues: $45,183,036 [Netflix FY2025 annual report / Form 10-K | netflix | FY2025 Q4 | p. 42].  
- Netflix FY2025 cost of revenues: $23,275,329 [Netflix FY2025 annual report / Form 10-K | netflix | FY2025 Q4 | p. 42].
